stop_condition: stop if localization cannot preserve the 5400-episode denominator

allowed_updates: M2364 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the design
next_stage_criteria: target and guardrail slice schema is specified

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2364 designs outcome localization and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2364; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU comparison verdict is run.

success_criteria: offtrack target and R4 collision guardrail/semantics slices are specified
ranking, winner selection, paper-level, finite-window-vs-GRU, and level3 self-ID claims remain blocked
a bounded non-ranking follow-up route is selected or branch is stopped
